scope: Historical initial form-only focused regressions; subsequent CI found a shared action normalization defect, repaired and qualified in money-boundary/repair.json. No browser, hosted identity or deployment claim.

form_semantics.arithmetic: integer strings; no binary floating point
form_semantics.json_boundary: No conversion; typed values stay unchanged until independent storage compatibility validation

refusals: noncanonical noninteger JSON minor units at storage compatibility check
limits: Actual native keyboard and accessibility-tree behavior is qualified by APP-160 separately.
No real screen-reader announcement is inferred from these tests.
calendar_boundary: Storage uses the existing contract grammar to refuse impossible days/months, invalid leap days and out-of-range UTC clocks before a command can persist them.
